params.command: $wt="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-pr90-integration"; Set-Location $wt; $json=Get-ChildItem BuildLogs\verification-report-*.json | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; 'REPORT='+$json.FullName; $doc=Get-Content -Raw $json.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json; $doc.results | Where-Object { $_.status -ne 'PASS' } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8; 'FAIL_LINES_BEGIN'; $log=Get-ChildItem BuildLogs\verify-*.log | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; Select-String -Path $log.FullName -Pattern 'FAIL:|failed|Failed|ERROR|Exception' -Context 3,8 | ForEach-Object {$_.ToString()}; 'FAIL_LINES_END'
